ExportNVMeDeviceLogs.description: The ExportNVMeDeviceLogs operation shall be used to export the storage device logs.
ExportNVMeDeviceLogs.longDescription: The ExportNVMeDeviceLogs operation shall be used to export the storage device logs.

enumDescriptions.Disable: Ignoring of certificate warning is Disable.
enumDescriptions.Enable: Ignoring of certificate warning is Enable.

OperationalState.description: The operational state of the physical disk.

enumDescriptions.BackgroundInitialization: The physical disk is undergoing background initialization.
enumDescriptions.CheckConsistency: The physical disk is undergoing a check consistency operation.
enumDescriptions.Clear: The data on the physical disk is being erased.
enumDescriptions.Copyback: The data is being copied back from a hot spare to a replacement physical disk.
enumDescriptions.Initialize: The physical disk or logical disk is being initialized.
enumDescriptions.Learn: The battery is undergoing a reconditioning cycle.
enumDescriptions.Rebuild: The physical disk is being rebuilt after a failure.
enumDescriptions.Reconstruct: The virtual disk associated with the physical disk is being reconstructed.
enumDescriptions.TTYExport: The log is being exported from the TTY interface.

OperationalState.longDescription: This type shall contain the operational state of the physical disk as reported by the RAID controller.

PendingChange.description: The type of pending change for the physical disk.

enumDescriptions.CancelRebuildPhysicalDisk: A cancel rebuild operation is pending.
enumDescriptions.HotSpare: A hot spare assignment change is pending.
enumDescriptions.SecureErase: A secure erase operation is pending.
enumDescriptions.SecureErasePSID: A secure erase PSID operation is pending.

PendingChange.longDescription: This type shall contain the types of pending changes for the physical disk configuration.

enumDescriptions.EnabledProxyDefault: Proxy Support to be Enabled and set to default.

enumDescriptions.HTTP: Proxy type is of HTTP type.
enumDescriptions.SOCKS4: Proxy type is of SOCKS4 type.

RaidStatus.longDescription: This type shall contain the RAID specific status as reported by the RAID controller.

SecurityStatus.description: The security status of the physical disk.

enumDescriptions.Foreign: The physical disk contains a foreign security configuration.
enumDescriptions.ForeignLocked: The physical disk is foreign and locked.
enumDescriptions.ForeignSecured: The physical disk is foreign and secured.
enumDescriptions.Unsecured: The physical disk is unsecured or encryption capable.
enumDescriptions.Vulnerable: The physical disk is in a vulnerable state.

SecurityStatus.longDescription: This type shall contain the security status of the physical disk.

StorageCapability.description: The drive attribute capabilities of the physical disk.

enumDescriptions.ALTA: The drive is behind an ALTA bridge.
enumDescriptions.BlinkUnblinkCapable: The drive supports blink and unblink operations.
enumDescriptions.DIF: The drive supports Data Integrity Field.
enumDescriptions.EnhanceConfigLockdownCapable: The drive supports enhanced config lockdown.
enumDescriptions.EnhanceUpdateLockdownCapable: The drive supports enhanced update lockdown.
enumDescriptions.FDECapable: The drive is Full Disk Encryption capable.
enumDescriptions.HDDFarmLogSupported: The HDD drive supports FARM log.
enumDescriptions.NVMeBlockSanitize: The NVMe drive supports block sanitize.
enumDescriptions.NVMeCryptoSanitize: The NVMe drive supports crypto sanitize.
enumDescriptions.PDClearCapable: The drive supports PD clear operation.
enumDescriptions.PDUnmapCapable: The drive supports PD unmap operation.
enumDescriptions.PDUnmapCapableForVDConfig: The drive supports PD unmap for virtual disk configuration.
enumDescriptions.PassthruAdvHostPD: The drive is an advanced passthrough host physical disk.
enumDescriptions.PassthruHostPD: The drive is a passthrough host physical disk.
enumDescriptions.PostProcessingFlag: The drive has a post processing flag set.
enumDescriptions.PrepareToRemoveCapable: The drive supports prepare to remove operation.
enumDescriptions.RTPartialInventory: Real-time partial drive inventory is supported.
enumDescriptions.SEKMLocked: The drive is locked by Secure Enterprise Key Management (SEKM) key.
enumDescriptions.SSD: The media type of the drive is Solid State.
enumDescriptions.SecureEraseCapable: The drive is Secure Erase capable.
enumDescriptions.SmartAlert: The drive has a SMART alert present.
enumDescriptions.UnknownMediaType: The drive has an unknown media type.
enumDescriptions.VOSS: The drive is a VOSS drive.
